# gramlot-examples 0.3.40 — gallery review fixes

Requires gramlot 0.3.32.

- Uploader lessons state whether the server accepts uploads and name the galleries that do (Uvicorn, serverless).
- The Logic folder page renders again.
- Real-time · System monitor works on Kajenn: the sampling runs on its own event loop when the store starts in a worker thread.
- Support pages with `catalogued: false` no longer appear in the navigation tree.
- The Kajenn database lesson opens with a customer loaded and offers a choice of real customers.
- Links between lessons open inside the gallery; links to the manual point to the published documentation.
- Charts with a grid no longer show the ".selectionLength" message and empty grid toolbars are hidden (gramlot 0.3.32).
